story: A five-man breakaway formed early but never gained more than two minutes. Teams UAE, Jayco and Soudal drove a hard pace to reel them in, with crosswinds creating echelons that dropped some well placed GC riders. In the sprint finish, Lampaert led out before Gaviria launched his sprint early, but Merlier overpowered him in the final meters to win and reclaim the leader's jersey
